ENVO UP20 Ride-On Electric Transporter Platform | Modular Utility EV, Industrial Cart and Specialty LEV
The ENVO UP20 is a compact ride-on electric transporter platform based on UPT technology, created for businesses and institutions that need a right-sized alternative to full-size service vehicles, utility carts, burden carriers, maintenance carts, and internal transport equipment. Quiet, efficient, highly maneuverable, and designed for indoor and outdoor operation, the UP20 platform can support warehouse logistics, production-line replenishment, hospital transportation, airport baggage handling, film production, construction support, mobile retail, municipal services, campus operations, farm work, landscaping, security patrol, emergency response, resort transportation, and other specialized light electric vehicle applications.
Accessories shown may be optional, not included in the base price, or unavailable for individual sale. Check the product configuration or contact us for details.
